policy: Independent composition-specific instrument and performance choices. No dissonance filter, pitch/detune limit, integer-harmonic requirement, universal tempo ceiling, decay ceiling, dynamic limiter or common loudness target. Only finite/alias-safe PCM, codec validity and unclipped playback are technical requirements.
comparisonMethod: Archived v1/v2/v3 native analyses reused. New v4 native decode measured. Numbers describe recordings, not artistic acceptance criteria; no subjective audition performed.

validation.method: Native24k decode and MP3 gapless correlation;96k interpolation peak scan; finite PCM, zero clipping, local boundary continuity and conservative two music peaks plus maximum natural ambience. No shared artistic limits or loudness-equality assertion.
